gen-dafont-minecraftia-lora: Lora reads like a classic serif with a gentle swell in its curves and a broad, welcoming c, never harsh. Minecraftia is chunky and tall-lettered; Lora is the moderate one.
gen-dafont-nasalization-fs-rowan: Rowan keeps the text friendly, its curves opening generously and its thin strokes about half the weight of the thick. Rowan carries a longer passage easily, while Nasalization floats its short-ascender letters above.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with capitals sitting barely above its low lowercase, like a text serif. And Neuropol, drawn with poured-looking ink at one width, would look best set noticeably larger than that body.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-fs-rowan: Rowan reads like a friendly text serif, its curves wide open. Its stems and hairlines sit close in ratio, while Neuropolitical glows above in neon-tube lines of one steady thickness.
gen-dafont-nordic-fs-rowan: Ancient and powerful, Nordic scatters its monoweight letters far apart like brush dabs. Rowan, a serif with moderate lowercase height and generous curve openings, brings a literary friendliness that grounds the whole pair.
gen-dafont-over-there-fs-paquito: Over There looks drawn with a fixed-width nib, each glyph spaced well apart from its neighbors. Paquito, a text serif with barely any gap between x-height and caps, would feel confident and approachable down a long page.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-neco: Neco reads like a classic serif with a measured swell from hairline to stem, its curves never pinching shut. It feels dignified over a long page.
gen-dafont-ozone-fs-recia: Ozone cuts its letters like wire, high in the lowercase, with wide-set curve ends. Recia, a classic serif, does its best work in curves that thin out only modestly and stay generous.
gen-dafont-ozone-lora: Bookish and literary, Lora swells faintly in each curve like pulled taffy. Lora, a classic serif with a broad c, would settle into a long passage far more warmly than wire-like Ozone ever could.
gen-dafont-ozone-noto-serif: Ozone draws every counter with one steady line, capitals barely above lowercase. Noto Serif, a classic serif with prominent x-height and subtle thick and thin cadence, would carry a long passage with literary ease.
